watery.definitionKo: 진흙이나 반죽 등이 물기가 많아 부드럽게 질다.
watery.englishDescription: Mud, dough, etc., being wet and soft because it contains a large amount of water.

watery.definitionKo: 진흙이나 반죽 등이 물기가 많아 부드럽게 질다.
watery.englishDescription: Mud, dough, etc., being soft and wet because it contains a large amount of water.

wholly.englishDescription: In a manner of something being intact as it originally was.

wholly.definitionKo: 속에 들어 있는 액체가 모두 잇따라 자꾸 빠지는 모양.
wholly.englishDescription: In the manner of all the water or liquid being drained from a field, pool, etc.

whoopee.definitionKo: 반갑거나 기분이 좋아서 어쩔 줄을 모를 때 내는 소리.
whoopee.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker does not know what to do because he/she is glad or happy.

whoopee.definitionKo: 매우 흥겹고 즐거울 때 박자를 맞추며 내는 소리.
whoopee.englishDescription: An exclamation used when one is very happy and joyful while beating time.

whoopee.definitionKo: 흥겹거나 즐거울 때 가볍게 장단을 맞추며 내는 소리.
whoopee.englishDescription: An exclamation used when one is happy or joyful while beating time lightly.

wick.definitionKo: 초나 등잔 등에 불을 붙이기 위해 꼬아서 꽂은 실이나 헝겊.
wick.englishDescription: A twisted string or fabric inserted to light a candle or oil lamp, etc.

wick.definitionKo: 폭탄 등을 터뜨리기 위해 불을 붙이게 되어 있는 줄.
wick.englishDescription: A string ignited to blow up an explosive, etc.

wick.definitionKo: 초의 속에 있는, 불이 붙어 타는 실 등의 물건.
wick.englishDescription: Something like a thread in the inside of a candle, which burns while the candle is burning.

wink.englishDescription: A short period of time during which one takes a rest or sleeps.

wipe.englishDescription: To wipe away something that clings to the surface.
To wipe dirt or wet liquids with a mop.
To rub to eliminate dirty things.

wipe.definitionKo: 바닥이나 겉 부분의 지저분한 것을 문질러서 깎거나 닦아 내다.
wipe.englishDescription: To remove or wipe off something messy on a floor or surface by rubbing on it.

wipe.definitionKo: 물기나 먼지 등이 묻은 것을 닦아 없애다.
wipe.englishDescription: To wipe off moisture or dust, etc.

woo-hoo.englishDescription: An exclamation that several people shout vigorously.
An exclamation that several people shout together vigorously.

workroom.englishDescription: A room where one does work.

year-end.englishDescription: The act of bidding the old year out.
